answer: Each claim must build a bridge from its own verified work to the public mesa — a flat-topped plateau of every identity's ledger — plank by plank, each plank one of its own jobs, riveted with copper that costs 40 POA, burned on use. A clone's copied bridge has no true planks: its copper rivets shear under the first peer crossing, the span drops, and the claim falls. Rivets cannot be lent or shared, so a hundred clones must build a hundred true bridges and burn 4,000 POA.
